comparison.objective: Tune and secure a robot-axis shock absorber, versus route a parcel through a spring-closing gate onto a running conveyor.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate uses precision hex-key engagement, retained-fastener handling, collar micro-rotation, torque control, and repeated guarded actuation. PR-1277 uses sustained bimanual coordination: one hand resists a spring gate while the other slides and routes a parcel, then safely releases the gate.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires two repeatable safe stops plus verified lock retention. PR-1277 requires passage only through the gateway with no gate contact or lifting, delivery upright to the run-off plate, gate closure, and both arms returned.
comparison.reason: Although both include physical control under load and bimanual stabilization, one tests precision commissioning of an adjustable energy absorber and the other tests collision-free object routing while managing a self-closing barrier. Missing numeric candidate definitions for excessive rebound, overload, and drift do not imply overlap.
